scope.sourcePolicy: Official per-major PostgreSQL application documentation, stable-branch source parser/option table, security advisories, and release notes.

archiveInput.positionalInput: archive filename or directory; omission means stdin
archiveInput.standardInput: supported for non-parallel archive input; cannot safely share stdin with --filter=-
archiveInput.plain: not supported by pg_restore; restore plain pg_dump scripts with psql
archiveInput.parallel: --jobs > 1 requires custom/directory archive and a regular file/directory input; ignored for script output

executionModes.directDatabase: --dbname; executes SQL directly against target; --file and --restrict-key are incompatible
executionModes.script: --file; generated SQL script, with '-' representing stdout

environments.intentionallyNotUsedAsImplicitDb: PGDATABASE is not read to select direct-database mode when --dbname is absent
environments.inherited: libpq environment variables apply for database connections. Passwords should use libpq password mechanisms; PgCliSharp does not put passwords on the command line.

validationRules.require: database output and --file output are mutually exclusive
data-only and schema-only are mutually exclusive
data-only and clean are mutually exclusive
when jobs > 1 actually applies, archive must be custom/directory and input must be regular file/directory; script-output ignored behavior is not prohibited
--restrict-key requires script output and an exact executable version at/after the security-backport boundary
at most one stdin filter and no simultaneous archive-stdin consumer
data-only/schema-only/statistics-only are pairwise exclusive; each conflicts with corresponding no-*; statistics conflicts with no-statistics and with data-only/schema-only

inventoryVerification.method: Compared resolved long-option spellings with REL_10_STABLE through REL_18_STABLE src/bin/pg_dump/pg_restore.c cmdopts[] tables; utility --help/--version handled separately because source recognizes them before getopt.
inventoryVerification.result: Exact source-table inventory captured for all majors; no unexplained source/spec options remain.
noteworthyParserFindings: PG10-11 allow script stdout by omission; PG12+ normal restore requires -d or -f unless --list.
PG17 transaction-size is 1..INT_MAX and implies exit-on-error.
PG18 adds statistics content modes and exact full-name format parsing.

sourceLevelVerification.result: Complete option-table and hard-validation audit performed across REL_10_STABLE..REL_18_STABLE.

apiCoverageVerification.result: All inventory entries have an explicit public API or wrapper binding. CI reflection tests verify typed property bindings, and version-varying entries are compared with the runtime availability catalog.

designDecisions.input: Dedicated PgRestoreInput models archive file/directory/stdin; archive input is not an arbitrary option string.
designDecisions.output: Dedicated PgRestoreOutput models direct database vs SQL/list stream/file output.
designDecisions.noOvervalidation: Options documented/upstream-implemented as ignored in a mode (for example parallel jobs during script generation) are not rejected merely for being ineffective.
designDecisions.secrets: No password value command-line option exists; environment values are not rendered in diagnostics.
